description: Active storefront user of the given store with the given BIWW role, created as in Web Admin > Users > Add New (no password; tests reach it through an Admin's Shop As); created per test and deleted at teardown. Story BMP-94.

role.description: Stored role name (dbo.AspNetRoles.Name, Commerce Portal): SalesRep, MarketCoordinator, Web Admin or Super Admin (Add New labels: Sales Representative, Market Coordinator, Admin, Super Admin)

store.description: Store code the user belongs to (ZnodePortal.StoreCode), sent as storeCode of the BIWW create
